{ "item": { "id": "3687b2b5-3b2b-402f-8464-1b3108edb0dd", "content_type": "generic", "workflow_state": "public", "page_title": "Installation", "short_description": "Install the Godzilla SDK or start calling the REST API directly.", "body": "

Installation

Godzilla has no server to install — it's a hosted platform you reach over the REST API, either directly or through an SDK.

Option A: Use an SDK

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=npm install @godzilla/sdk # or pip install godzilla-sdk # or go get github.com/godzilla/godzilla-go}}

Full setup for each is in Node.js SDK, Python SDK, and Go SDK.

Option B: Call the API directly

No install needed — every endpoint in the API reference is a plain HTTPS request.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=curl https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v3/pipelines \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY"}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Next|body_html=

Either way, you'll need an API key before you can make a request — that's covered in Authentication, next.

}} {{ds:component/docs-pagination|prev_href={{cms:item/ef3e45c9-7188-4f79-b239-3efd7660796a}}|prev_label=Concepts|next_href={{cms:item/adeb581a-d09e-46bf-832b-70ee29b8a205}}|next_label=Quickstart}}", "version_token": "adc9d6eb-4f8d-4ef6-ac91-48e2fedc5243", "created_at": "2026-08-22T01:13:58.709Z", "updated_at": "2026-08-22T01:14:23.330Z", "placement_id": "2ecfa220-7e12-44f0-bde9-1b6ca416508d", "folder_id": "826d5765-bef8-4e7e-8aa6-d01652b9ecc0", "file_name": "getting-started-installation" } }

Authentication

Every request to the Godzilla API is authenticated with a bearer API key.

Getting an API key

args.short_description: Authenticate API requests with a bearer API key.
args.body:
Authentication

Every request to the Godzilla API is authenticated with a bearer API key.

Getting an API key

Generate one from your workspace settings. Keys are scoped to a single workspace and inherit the standard rate limit described in Rate limits.

Using the key

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=curl https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v3/pipelines \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY"}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=client.go|language=go|code=import "github.com/godzilla/godzilla-go" client := godzilla.NewClient(os.Getenv("GODZILLA_API_KEY"))}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=Never expose a key client-side|body_html=

API keys carry full workspace access. Keep them server-side only — never embed one in a mobile app, browser bundle, or public repository.

}}

Verifying webhook requests

Incoming webhook deliveries are authenticated differently: by a signed X-Godzilla-Signature header rather than your API key.

{{ds:component/docs-pagination|prev_href={{cms:item/a23561f2-7753-4d51-abc0-ed541494fc37}}|prev_label=Quickstart|next_href={{cms:item/352ec90a-373b-4f4a-aef2-e91062945b99}}|next_label=Building your first pipeline}}
